name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 128 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Tel Aviv.
status.nb: 128 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Tel Aviv.

summary.en: Israeli airstrikes have hit a building in Nuseirat, killing civilians, while attacks on West Bank olive farmers have escalated, with Israeli forces killing two gunmen in a Hebron clash. Netanyahu has ordered a very extensive operation and a lockdown of the West Bank after two Israeli soldiers were killed by suspected Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint. The Israeli government also announced a closure of the West Bank following the shooting that wounded five Israelis. These steps expand the scope of Israeli military actions beyond previous raids and farmer attacks. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske luftangrep har truffet en bygning i Nuseirat, og drept sivile, mens angrep på oljebønder på Vestbredden har eskalert, med israelske styrker som drepte to væpnede menn i en sammenstøt i Hebron. Netanyahu har beordret en svært omfattende operasjon og en nedstengning av Vestbredden etter at to israelske soldater ble drept av mistenkte palestinske væpnede ved en kontrollpost. Den israelske regjeringen kunngjorde også en stenging av Vestbredden etter skytingen som såret fem israelere. Disse tiltakene utvider omfanget av israelske militære handlinger utover tidligere raid og angrep på bønder. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.

posts.author: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Two Palestinian gunmen attacked a road junction near Hebron on Friday, prompting Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to direct Israel’s military to prepare for a “full lockdown” of the West Bank.

The militant group Hamas claimed responsibility for the attack.
